D2-340.q: Microsoft Foundry mein agent ki instructions kaise likhte hain?
opts: SQL query jo agent ke usool chunti hai
Binary file jise agent load karta hai
Aam zaban mein, jo role aur usool bataye
D2-340.exp: Agent ki instructions system message ki tarah saada aam zaban hoti hain, jo model ko batati hain ke woh kaun hai, kya karna hai aur kaunse usool par chalna hai. SQL, binary files aur stylesheets se agent ka rawaiya tay nahi hota.

D2-341.ctx: Ek IT help desk agent ko IT knowledge base documents se sawalon ke jawab dene hain aur ticketing system mein tickets banane hain, jis ka REST API OpenAPI specification mein bayan hai.
D2-341.q: Agent ke paas kaunse tools hone chahiye?
opts: Image generation aur Grounding with Bing Search
Koi tool nahi, kyunke instructions kaafi hain
D2-341.exp: File search agent ko knowledge base documents se jawab dene deta hai, aur OpenAPI tool usay tickets banane ke liye ticketing system ka API call karne deta hai. Code interpreter Python chalata hai, image generation aur web search andruni systems tak nahi pohanchte, aur akeli instructions documents ya APIs tak rasai nahi deti.

D2-342.q: Microsoft Foundry mein agents ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Jab model agent ke taur par kaam kare to us ki deployment ke guardrails lagu nahi rehte.
Agent ko sirf public website par shaya hone ke baad test kiya ja sakta hai.
Aap model badle baghair agent ke tools badal sakte hain.
D2-342.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: deployment ki content filtering aur doosre guardrails tab bhi lagu rehte hain jab model agent ke taur par kaam kare. Doosre ka Nahi: agent ko kisi bhi waqt portal mein ya code se test kiya ja sakta hai. Teesre ka Haan: tools aur model definition ke alag hisse hain.

D2-343.q: Har agent tool ko knowledge tool ya action tool mein rakhein. Har category ek se zyada baar istemal ho sakti hai.
targets: Action tool (doosre system mein kuch karta hai)
D2-343.exp: File search aur Azure AI Search jawab ki bunyad ke liye maloomat nikalte hain, is liye woh knowledge tools hain. Function calling aur OpenAPI tool agent ko aisa code ya APIs chalane dete hain jo doosre systems mein amal karein, is liye woh action tools hain.

D2-344.q: Ek agent kabhi kabhi ghalat tool call karta hai. Kaunsi DO tabdeeliyan sab se zyada madad karengi? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Instructions aur tool descriptions mein wazeh batana ke har tool kab istemal ho
Woh tools hatana jin ki agent ko zaroorat nahi
Mazeed ghair mutalliqa tools shamil karna
D2-344.exp: Model tools ko un ki descriptions aur apni instructions ki bunyad par chunta hai, is liye wazeh rahnumai tool ka intikhab behtar karti hai, aur kam ghair mutalliqa tools se ghalat intikhab ke mauqay kam hote hain. Quota aur agent ka naam tool ke intikhab par asar nahi dalte, aur izafi ghair mutalliqa tools ghaltiyan barhate hain.

D2-345.q: Agents ke baare mein jumla mukammal karein.
D2-345.tpl: Agent ka rawaiya us ki {0} se tay hota hai, aur woh model se aage ki maloomat ya systems tak pohanchne ke liye {1} istemal karta hai.
D2-345.exp: Instructions agent ka role, usool aur andaz tay karti hain, aur file search, web grounding ya API calls jaise tools usay model ki maloomat se aage le jate hain. Regions, deployment types aur quotas hosting ki settings hain jo rawaiya tay nahi kartin na data tak rasai deti hain.

D2-346.q: Agent ke file search tool ke liye upload ki hui files kahan rakhi jati hain taake agent un mein talash kar sake?
D2-346.exp: Upload ki hui files chunks mein tor kar, embed kar ke vector store mein rakhi jati hain, jahan file search tool mutalliqa hisse dhoondta hai. Woh model ke weights nahi badaltin, system message mein paste nahi hotin aur browser cache mein nahi rakhi jatin.

D2-347.q: Foundry quickstart Python client mein project par authenticate karne ke liye kaunsi credential class istemal karta hai?
D2-347.exp: Quickstart azure-identity ka DefaultAzureCredential istemal karta hai, jo development mein aap ka az login session aur Azure mein managed identity pakar leta hai. Code mein passwords, anonymous rasai aur storage SAS tokens Foundry project par authenticate karne ke liye istemal nahi hote.

D2-348.q: Ek client poore jawab ka intezar karne ke bajaye agent ka jawab bante hi dikhana chahta hai. Usay kya karna chahiye?
opts: Billing page ko baar baar check kare
Har message ke liye agent dobara banana
Response stream kar ke har chunk dikhana
D2-348.exp: Streaming response ko model ke banate hue hi hisson mein deti hai, is liye client text foran dikha sakta hai. Billing check karna, agent dobara banana aur quota barhana adhoora output dastiyab nahi karta.

D2-349.q: Agent client apps ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Client ko har request ke saath agent ki tool definitions nahi bhejni partin.
Conversation ID se client baad mein chat jari rakh sakta hai.
Client app Foundry portal mein bane agent se baat kar sakti hai.
D2-349.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: tools agent ki mehfooz definition ka hissa hain. Doosre ka Haan: conversation ID dobara istemal karne se pehle ki history wapas aati hai. Teesre ka Haan: portal mein bane agents code se naam ke zariye istemal ho sakte hain.

D2-350.q: Agent client code ki har line ko us ke kaam se milayein. Har tafseel ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
targets: Agent ka model aur instructions bayan karta hai
Maujooda identity ke liye Microsoft Entra tokens leta hai
D2-350.exp: DefaultAzureCredential tokens leta hai, AIProjectClient project se jurta hai, PromptAgentDefinition agent ka model aur instructions bayan karti hai, aur conversations.delete conversation aur us ki history hatata hai. In mein se koi line tasveer nahi banati.

D2-351.q: Foundry SDK se prompt agent banane ke liye kaunsi DO values chahiye? Har sahi jawab hal ka ek hissa hai.
D2-351.exp: create_version() agent ka naam aur aisi definition leta hai jis mein model deployment ka naam, aam taur par instructions ke saath, hota hai. Agents Foundry ke managed infrastructure par chalte hain, is liye GPU, storage queue ya DNS zone ki zaroorat nahi.

D2-352.ctx: Ek web app 1,000 employees ko ek hi HR agent se chat karne deti hai. Har employee ki chat private rehni chahiye.
D2-352.q: Client ko conversations kaise sambhalni chahiye?
opts: Sab ke liye ek mushtarka conversation istemal kare
Bheje jane wale har message ke liye naya agent banana
Rasai aasan karne ke liye authentication band karna
Har user session ke liye conversation banana
D2-352.exp: Har user session ko apni conversation chahiye taake history kabhi na mile, aur app ko yaqeeni banana hota hai ke ek user doosre ki conversation ID istemal na kar sake. Mushtarka conversation maloomat leak karti hai, har message par agents banana fuzool hai, aur authentication band karne se access control khatam ho jata hai.

D2-353.q: Woh Python code mukammal karein jo agent banata aur us ka naam aur version print karta hai.
D2-353.exp: PromptAgentDefinition prompt-based agent ko us ke model aur instructions ke saath bayan karti hai. create_version() agent version object deta hai, jis mein name aur version jaisi properties hain. SpeechConfig aur ImageAnalysisClient doosri services ka hissa hain, aur temperature aur region mile hue agent ki properties nahi.

D2-354.q: Python ke Language SDK mein analyze_sentiment() ko documents ke taur par kya dete hain?
opts: Ek image jis ke andar text ho
WAV file jis mein reviews parhe gaye hon
Strings ya text objects ki list
D2-354.exp: Text analysis ke methods documents ka batch lete hain, ya to saada strings ki soorat mein ya id, text aur ikhtiyari language wale objects ki soorat mein. Tasveerein, audio files aur schemas sentiment analysis ka durust input nahi.

D2-355.q: Ek app ko customer reviews ke batch ko ek dostana paragraph mein badalna hai jo bataye ke customers ko kya pasand aur kya napasand hai. Kya sab se munasib hai?
opts: Khulasay ki wazeh hidayaat wala chat model
D2-355.exp: Chune hue lehje mein naya paragraph likhna generative kaam hai, is liye wazeh hidayaat wala chat model munasib hai. Language detection aur PII detection khulasa nahi karte, aur akele key phrases parhne wale paragraph ke bajaye mauzu ki list dete hain.

D2-356.q: Text analysis apps ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: App Azure Language features ko generative model ke saath jor sakti hai.
Zaati data ko haath se dhoond kar chupana lazmi hai.
Azure Language English text ka jaiza leta hai aur baqi zabanon ka pehle tarjuma karna parta hai.
D2-356.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: maslan app Language se sentiment maloom kar ke model se jawab likhwa sakti hai. Doosre ka Nahi: PII detection zaati data khud dhoond kar chupata hai. Teesre ka Nahi: Language features bohat si zabanein support karte hain, har feature ki list alag hai.

D2-357.q: Har zaroorat ko TextAnalyticsClient ke us method se milayein jo usay pura karta hai. Har method ek baar istemal ho sakta hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Har review ke liye positive, neutral ya negative
Text ki copy jis mein zaati data chupa ho
D2-357.exp: analyze_sentiment() sentiment ke labels deta hai, extract_key_phrases() mauzu, detect_language() zaban, aur recognize_pii_entities() redacted text. speak_text_async() Speech SDK ka hissa hai aur audio banata hai.

D2-358.q: TextAnalyticsClient ki authentication ke baare mein jumlay mukammal karein.
D2-358.tpl: Resource key istemal karne ke liye client {0} ke saath banayein. Microsoft Entra ID istemal karne ke liye us ki jagah {1} dein.
D2-358.exp: AzureKeyCredential key authentication ke liye key rakhta hai, aur DefaultAzureCredential Microsoft Entra tokens deta hai. SpeechConfig aur PromptAgentDefinition doosre SDKs ka hissa hain, aur API version ya deployment ka naam credential nahi.

D2-359.q: Record kiya hua sawal audio wale chat model ko bhejne se pehle app ko recording ke saath kya karna hota hai?
opts: Usay awaaz ki lehar ki image mein badalna
Usay print kar ke transcript ke pages scan karna
Usay base64 mein encode kar ke format batana
Usay French ya kisi aur zaban mein translate karna
D2-359.exp: Audio request mein base64-encoded data ki soorat mein apne format, jaise wav, ke saath shamil hoti hai. Model ko audio ki tasveer nahi chahiye, print karne se kuch nahi hota, aur sawal samajhne ke liye tarjuma zaroori nahi.

D2-360.q: Ek app audio wale chat model se speech mein jawab maangti hai. Chat Completions response mein audio kahan milti hai?
D2-360.exp: Jab audio output maanga jaye to assistant message mein audio object hota hai jis ki data property mein base64-encoded audio, aur saath mein boli gayi baat ka transcript hota hai. image_url image input ke liye hai, usage sirf tokens ki tadad batata hai, aur audio headers mein nahi aati.

D2-361.q: Spoken prompts ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Audio wala model apne bole hue jawab ke saath transcript deta hai.
Agar model zaban support kare to spoken prompt English ke ilawa kisi zaban mein ho sakta hai.
Audio wale model ki har request se pehle Speech resource call karna lazmi hai.
D2-361.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: audio output ke saath text transcript aata hai jise app dikha ya log kar sakti hai. Doosre ka Haan: audio wale models bohat si boli jane wali zabanein sambhalte hain. Teesre ka Nahi: model audio khud process karta hai, is liye alag Speech call ikhtiyari hai.

D2-362.q: Aap ki app se bolne wale users ko jawab dene ke kaunse DO durust tareeqay hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Audio audio wale chat model ko bhejna
Audio sirf embedding model ko bhejna
Speech to text se likhna, phir text chat model ko bhejna
D2-362.exp: Audio wala chat model speech ka seedha jawab de sakta hai, aur speech to text ke baad chat model wali pipeline bhi kaam karti hai. Image-generation models, embedding models aur OCR bole hue sawalon ke jawab nahi dete.

D2-363.q: SpeechConfig(subscription=key, region=region) mein region kya hai?
opts: Woh Azure region jahan resource hai
D2-363.exp: Region SDK ko batata hai ke aap ke Speech ya Foundry resource ka kaunsa regional endpoint call karna hai, maslan eastus. Awaazein speech_synthesis_voice_name se, zabanein speech_recognition_language se set hoti hain, aur Speech yahan model deployment ka naam istemal nahi karta.

D2-364.q: Continuous recognition ke dauran SpeechRecognizer ka kaunsa event har pehchane hue phrase ka aakhri text deta hai?
D2-364.exp: recognized event har phrase ke aakhri nateeje ke saath chalta hai. recognizing kisi ke bolte waqt adhoore, badalte hue nateejon ke saath baar baar chalta hai, canceled errors ya rukne ki khabar deta hai, aur session_started session shuru hone ka nishan hai.

D2-365.q: Speech SDK ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: SpeechConfig woh text rakhta hai jo bola jayega.
Audio config ke baghair SpeechRecognizer error deta hai.
SpeechSynthesizer speak_ssml_async() ke zariye SSML bolta hai.
D2-365.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: SpeechConfig connection ki tafseel aur settings rakhta hai; text synthesizer ke speak methods ko diya jata hai. Doosre ka Nahi: AudioConfig ke baghair default microphone istemal hota hai. Teesre ka Haan: speak_ssml_async() bareek control ke liye SSML leta hai.

D2-366.q: Woh Python code mukammal karein jo SSML document bolta aur tasdeeq karta hai ke audio bani.
D2-366.exp: speak_ssml_async() SSML leta hai, jab ke speak_text_async() saada text leta hai aur recognize_once_async() pehchan karta hai. Kamyab synthesis SynthesizingAudioCompleted deta hai; RecognizedSpeech aur NoMatch speech recognition ke nateeje hain.

D2-367.q: Aap aisa Python code likh rahe hain jo boli hui English ke ek jumlay ko German text mein translate karta hai. Qadam sahi tarteeb mein rakhein. Har qadam istemal nahi hota.
items: Key aur region ke saath SpeechTranslationConfig banayein
TranslationRecognizer banayein aur ek baar pehchan karein
Recognition language English karein aur German ko target language ke taur par shamil karein
D2-367.exp: Pehle translation config banti hai, phir us par source aur target zabanein set hoti hain, phir us config se TranslationRecognizer banta aur sunta hai, aur aakhir mein nateeje ki translations dictionary German text deti hai. ImageAnalysisClient images ka jaiza leti hai aur zaroori nahi.
